buildPolicy: Exact versions and Cargo/npm lockfiles; builds offline and locked. Network is limited to explicit locked-input preparation, configured user services and actual owned-release delivery tests.
reviewScope: Source, license, dependency defaults and loading behavior checked. This record is not a security certification or a claim that all transitive licenses have been independently audited.

components.name: quick-xml
components.purpose: Bounded, namespace-aware math XML parsing
components.loading: Rust core; no external runtime or network calls
components.maintenanceReview: Pinned published Rust source inspected; input length and nesting limits are enforced by ReadMD.

components.name: yrs
components.purpose: UTF-16 CRDT, relative positions and persisted collaboration
components.loading: Rust collaboration service; no external runtime
components.maintenanceReview: Pinned Rust release inspected; real Yjs interoperability, duplicates, out-of-order recovery, concurrent clients, permissions and snapshots tested.

components.name: hayagriva
components.purpose: Offline CSL processing of BibTeX and CSL JSON
components.loading: Rust core, including its pinned style/locale archive
components.maintenanceReview: Published source and archive inspected; output is serialized with ReadMD escaping rather than trusting raw HTML. Complex style projection remains explicitly diagnosed.

components.name: Hayagriva bundled CSL styles and locales
components.purpose: Author-attributed offline style archive; separate from Rust source license
components.maintenanceReview: Names, original identifiers, authors, contributors, rights and update dates extracted from the exact locked archive. Style modifications must retain attribution and applicable share-alike notices.

components.name: yjs
components.purpose: Browser collaboration protocol and personal undo
components.loading: Only the collaboration page loads vendor/yjs.bundle.js (86074 bytes); ordinary reading does not load it.
components.maintenanceReview: Version and integrity locked in tools/collaboration-bundle/package-lock.json; tested against Yrs 0.28.0.

components.name: lib0
components.purpose: Yjs protocol helpers
components.loading: Included in the lazy Yjs bundle

components.name: esbuild
components.purpose: Offline collaboration bundle tooling
components.loading: Development only; node_modules and esbuild executables are excluded from the application.

components.name: pdfium-render
components.purpose: PDF object API in an optional disposable Rust worker
components.loading: Feature pdfium-worker only; not linked into the ordinary desktop build. Exact Cargo version; V8/XFA and default image/network features disabled.
components.maintenanceReview: Source and library ABI checked against pinned PDFium 7881. AES permission enum and cross-reader annotation differences are handled in ReadMD; native regression coverage is recorded separately.

components.name: PDFium Windows x64 runtime
components.license: BSD-3-Clause; separate third-party notices; binary package scripts MIT
components.notice: Offline pack licenses/pdfium.txt, LICENSE and 15 upstream notices
components.purpose: Optional native page-object rendering and modification
components.loading: Only a reviewed, hashed DLL in a bounded worker. No V8/XFA; never loaded into the reader process.
components.maintenanceReview: Upstream release archive SHA-256 verified against the GitHub release digest. DLL SHA-256 pinned in Rust and application lock. Install checks every file and runs an actual render/text probe. Other platform binaries have not been prepared or verified.

components.name: Microsoft Visual C++ app-local runtime
components.license: Microsoft Distributable Code; separate from ReadMD MIT license
components.purpose: Small required core support, bundled rather than requiring a globally installed VC Redistributable
components.loading: Two locked DLLs, 228728 bytes total, beside ReadMD.exe; owned workers inherit the application DLL directory
components.maintenanceReview: Official signed archive and DLL Authenticode checked; immutable source URL and SHA-256 in assets/runtimes/windows-x64/runtime.lock.json. Actual Windows process-module inspection verifies both main-reader DLLs and Typst worker runtime load from the bundled directory before System32. Windows 10/11 kernel/UCRT APIs and native GUI engine remain platform requirements.

components.name: Typst Windows x64 runtime
components.license: Apache-2.0; embedded dependency and font notices retained
components.purpose: Optional academic PDF typesetting
components.loading: Owned, pinned capability worker; bounded generated source/root, package imports disabled; absent during ordinary reading
components.maintenanceReview: Official release archive and runtime hashes locked. Actual compile, atomic output, vector figures, preview/output identity, repair and uninstall tested. CJK and additional language font delivery remains a separate gap; do not claim the engine's embedded fonts cover all 46 languages. See assets/capabilities/typst-0.15.1-windows-x64.lock.json.

components.name: Tesseract + Leptonica static OCR runtime
components.notice: Offline pack licenses/TESSERACT-LICENSE, licenses/LEPTONICA-LICENSE and NOTICE
components.purpose: Portable offline printed-text recognition
components.loading: On demand only; Rust decodes bounded image input, a static process reads local PNM and locked local models
components.maintenanceReview: Official source/model/tool digests in tools/ocr-runtime-inputs.lock.json; built offline with networking, codecs, GUI, training and legacy OCR disabled. PE imports checked: KERNEL32.dll only. Six real image formats, scanned PDF, cancellation, corrupt-model repair and restart tested without third-party runtimes in PATH. Handwriting and universal OCR accuracy are not certified.

components.name: tessdata_fast English, simplified Chinese and traditional Chinese models
components.purpose: Three locally installed OCR language models
components.loading: Only the managed OCR process loads these files; no system OCR language-pack installation
components.maintenanceReview: Each official traineddata file has exact length and SHA-256 in the OCR source and application locks. These are recognition languages, not a claim of OCR coverage for all UI languages.

components.name: image and selected pure Rust codecs
components.license: MIT OR Apache-2.0; individual MIT/BSD notices retained
components.purpose: Core PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF and WebP decoding without system image programs
components.loading: Rust core; default features disabled; no AVIF, EXR, external codec libraries or Rayon
components.maintenanceReview: Exact feature/dependency metadata and source licenses reviewed; 15 newly resolved packages have hashed notices in image-codecs.json. Bounded input/decode allocation and malformed-input tests. Equivalent release-size baseline has not been measured.

components.name: vega-interpreter
components.purpose: Scientific Vega expressions under the application's production CSP
components.loading: Lazy 5046-byte browser bundle; desktop figures do not launch Node
components.maintenanceReview: Official npm integrity and SHA-256 locked in assets/vendor/diagrams/vega/interpreter.lock.json; real native CSP and vector export tested with system runtimes absent from PATH. Separate headless MCP Vega rendering still needs a portable solution.

components.name: yaml-rust2
components.purpose: Offline OpenAPI JSON/YAML parsing
components.loading: Rust core; default encoding feature disabled; no network or external runtime
components.maintenanceReview: Pure Rust YAML 1.2 parser; upstream declares stable API/basic maintenance. Exact published source reviewed. ReadMD limits depth, event count, aliases and expanded bytes, rejects duplicate keys and application-defined tags.

components.name: arraydeque
components.purpose: Bounded YAML scanner queue
components.loading: Rust core; default encoding feature disabled; no network or external runtime
components.maintenanceReview: Pinned scanner dependency. License and source inspected; no new runtime or script execution.

components.name: STIX Two Math core font
components.purpose: Core vector formula layout and native PDF symbol subsets, independent of installed Office/math fonts
components.loading: 1518116-byte unmodified TrueType resource compiled into the Rust core; lazy layout
components.maintenanceReview: Official immutable Git blob and SHA-256 in tools/publication-font-inputs.lock.json. OpenType MATH constants, Greek and supplementary-plane outlines and embedding permission tested. Host font directories are not searched.

components.name: ReadMD Chinese publication fonts
components.notice: Offline pack licenses/NotoSansSC-OFL.txt, licenses/NotoSerifSC-OFL.txt and NOTICE
components.purpose: Private Chinese sans/serif regular and real bold weights for PDF publishing
components.loading: Optional universal fonts capability pack; scoped to the app profile, not globally registered
components.maintenanceReview: Noto Sans SC and Noto Serif SC inputs pinned by Git identity and SHA-256. Static weight 400/700 derivatives are renamed ReadMD Sans SC/ReadMD Serif SC; original copyright and OFL retained. All glyphs preserved. Outputs fixed in tools/publication-static-fonts.lock.json. Further scripts, arbitrary Unicode, font substitution and native non-Windows evidence remain open.

components.name: fontTools resource preparation
components.purpose: Explicit offline preparation of static weight font resources
components.loading: Development only; not packaged, not invoked by runtime or ordinary application builds
components.maintenanceReview: Installed exact version checked. Official instancer semantics reviewed; input/output hashes locked. Normal application and capability-pack assembly read prepared locked bytes offline and do not need Python/fontTools.

footprintLimits.minimumRust: 1.88 (the existing encoding_rs lock already requires this version)
footprintLimits.coreBinaryDelta: Not yet measured against an equivalent release baseline; do not claim a percentage improvement.
footprintLimits.externalEngines: Windows x64 PDFium, Typst and static OCR engines plus a universal Chinese publication font pack are implemented. FFmpeg/whisper, TeX bundles, further script coverage, headless figures and other engine platforms remain pending. No claim that all 46 UI languages have complete export font coverage.
footprintLimits.packTransport: Raw POST /api/capabilities/upload, bounded at 128 MiB; no base64 request expansion or retained uploads copy. Payload files remain inert JSON/base64, optionally gzip-compressed, with application-locked manifests and per-file sizes/hashes.
footprintLimits.packBytes: Download/installed sizes and owned URLs in assets/capabilities/catalog.json; independent per-platform file locks in assets/capabilities/.
